newsitem.title: UK: ICI says DuPont story speculation - paper.
newsitem.headline: ICI says DuPont story speculation - paper.

text.p: Imperial Chemical Industries Plc dismissed as speculation a newspaper story that it was close to a deal with DuPont Co to sell a large part of its industrial chemicals operations, the Times said on Monday.
But a spokesman said it was prepared to sell some industrial chemicals assets to a rival.
The Sunday Times had said the potential package, worth an estimated $2 billion, would involve the sale of ICI's titanium dioxide company Tioxide.
The sale of a small part of ICI's recently acquired Unilever chemicals business to DuPont might also be included, the newspaper said.

An ICI spokesman was quoted by the Times as saying the report was speculation. But he added: "We have planned to float Tioxide as a separate entity. We have never ruled out the possibility of a trade sale."

"We bought the Unilever speciality business in a five billion pound deal that was completed last week .. we have to pay some money back quickly and so we have to look at disposals. That is the picture." -- London newsroom + 44 171 542 7717
